milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate near the daylight detector and face toward it, confirming visual identification. The daylight detector is at spawn-relative [-5, 2, -1] on an oak fence post at eye level. max_distance=6 provides a small buffer beyond the ~5.1-5.5 block spawn distance so the player doesn't need to stand right on top of it, while still requiring deliberate approach. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the detector rather than just passing nearby.
